get_atom_config: get a FermiNet configuration for running generic single-atom QMC simulations
adjust_nuclear_charge: adjust the nuclear charge and electron count for a single atom in a FermiNet config
run_single_atom_qmc: run a quantum Monte Carlo simulation for a single atom using the atom config module
set_spin_polarisation: set the spin polarisation for a single atom in the FermiNet atom configuration
configure_delta_charge: configure a fractional delta charge on a single atom in the FermiNet atom config
